# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** 10  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** States  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) (relative), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) (parent)

## Appearance

Paul Irving is a child with a beautiful face featuring delicate, refined features framed by a halo of chestnut brown curls. He possesses big, very dark blue eyes and closely resembles his father.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029)_

## Personality

Paul Irving is an uncommon, highly imaginative child whose rich internal world leads him to invent remarkable stories. Despite his strong inclination toward dreams and fancies, he is described as a fair-minded, remarkably clean, and exceptionally manly young boy who excels in games. Thoughtful, protective, and helpful toward younger students, he is regarded as a perfect little gentleman, known also for his perceptive insight and a simple desire to make a joyful noise.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), +3 more_

## History

Paul Irving moved from the [States](../codex/places.md#states) to live with his grandmother in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), three years after losing his mother. Upon joining the local school, he quickly formed a fondness for his new teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), often presenting her with flowers and sharing his vivid imagination. In a composition letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Paul detailed creative stories about his imaginary rock friends at the shore, though he clarified the fantastical journey was not real. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later brought him to visit Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Paul quickly bonded with the woman, unaware of her past romantic fallout with his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Following his father's sudden arrival in town and subsequent reconciliation with Miss Lavendar, Paul shared in the excitement leading up to their wedding. He ultimately attended the outdoor ceremony in the garden to celebrate his father and Miss Lavendar's marriage before they departed.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P22](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0022), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), +431 more_

## Quotes

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

Paul is a devoted student of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Their bond quickly deepens beyond the classroom into a close friendship, with Paul bringing her flowers and sharing his vivid imaginary stories. The two often take walks together and visit local acquaintances as companions.

- Friend of — teacher and pupil who visit friends together  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045), +2 more</sub>

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--paul-irving.md)

Paul's relationship with [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) is marked by Davy's one-sided jealousy. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) resents the affection and attention Paul receives, comparing himself to Paul and growing envious when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends time visiting him.

- Rival of — unilateral resentment and comparison  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--paul-irving.md)
